title: Additive Measurement on Path-Generated Domains: Directed Recovery in Rational Addiction
description: Archival release of the path-generated-domain stage of the Rational Relapse Theory research program, originally submitted as JME-S-26-00480. The paper shifts the primitive object from a recovery utility function to target-relative continuous paths and accessible ledgers, and studies a finite-cancellation and Stieltjes-representation route. Rational addiction is treated as the leading economic application. The release includes the English historical manuscript and a Chinese archival translation. Later versions substantially revise the primitives, terminology, and contribution claims.
